description: All Too Well is the Bible and Jake Gyllenhaal is the devil, and that's just facts 💅😤 The way she drags him for five and a half minutes straight over a scarf?? poetic cinema. 'You call me up again just to break me like a promise' is a top 5 lyric of all time and I will sob every single time. The Red era is her crying-into-a-sweater era and I live for it 🥹🔥
